name: glitch-interrupt
title: Glitch Interrupt
description: Random micro-glitches interrupt an otherwise calm element: RGB-split flickers, 1-frame clip slices and character substitutions fire on a seeded schedule, then the element returns to perfect stillness — decay, not a loop.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Seeded Random Interrupt: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
